$comment: Shape of content/downloads.json. Groups render in this order as headed tables on /download/. An item has a title, an optional description, and either a `file` (path under public/files/ — type, size and date are read from the file; a missing file fails the build) or a `url` (hosted elsewhere — set `type` and `size` yourself). `type` overrides the label derived from the extension.
